<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Tamagami Number 2''' is the trident-wielding guardian of the Second Demon World, the middle floor of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. He fights with lunges and winds that drag and push you around. When defeated he doesn't die: he drops the '''2-star Demon Realm Dragon Ball''' on his platform and goes back to sleep for an hour.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding the lair == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
Tamagami Number 2 sleeps on a stone platform on the Second Demon World, reached through the giant tunnel that starts at 0, 0 on the Third Demon World. The lairs of the Tamagamis are searched for while players are in the Demon Realm. Once his lair has been located, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] in any demon village sells the '''Tamagami Number Two Map''' for 16 Emeralds (4 uses).

<!--T:10-->
He wakes when a survival or adventure player comes within 32 blocks of his platform, or when you hit him.
</translate>

<translate>
== How the Tamagamis fight == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Red circles and lanes on the ground always mark where a move will land. Some moves leave a Tamagami '''exposed''' for a moment: while exposed it takes '''25% more damage'''. When badly hurt, a Tamagami turns into its '''Powered Up''' form, which uses its moves more often (75% of the cooldown) and with extra follow-ups.
</translate>

<translate>
== Moves == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
* '''Lunge.''' He dashes along a red lane. Powered Up, he lunges a second time. If the last lunge hits nobody, he overextends and is exposed.
* '''Whirlwinds.''' White hurricanes rise from the red circles under the players and pull you in.
* '''Gale.''' A violent wind pushes everyone the same way for a few seconds, harder and downward if you're in the air.
</translate>

<translate>
== Defeat and rewards == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
When his health runs out, Tamagami Number 2 drops the '''2-star Demon Realm Dragon Ball''' on his platform and becomes dormant for an hour before he can be fought again. The three Demon Realm Dragon Balls, one from each Tamagami, summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]] in the Demon Realm. They never scatter on their own and no radar finds them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).

<!--T:17-->
Every contributor with at least 7.5% of the points also rolls these default rewards (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses#Rewards|how world boss rewards work]]):
* '''×300 Attributes''' (guaranteed; the amount scales with your contribution): half as Attribute Points and half as Training Points, like quest rewards (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes#Attribute Points and Attributes rewards|Stats and Attributes]]).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Trident|Tamagami Trident]] (30%): a spear with long thrusts.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], the quest '''Tamagami Number 2''' asks you to defeat him on the Second Demon World.
</translate>
